column1: Fed funds futures as shown on the CME FedWatch tool  captured 2026-09-22. These are FedWatch's own inputs not CME settles -- the front contract is a blend of realized and expected EFFR and does not sit on a 0.0025 tick. Paired with 2026-09-22_probabilities.csv from the same screen  so comparing the two tests this repo's bootstrap against FedWatch's with no timing drift between them. The 2026-09-21 settles had already moved 2.5bp in ZQZ6 by this capture.
